scene: LOW TABLE-LEVEL OBSTRUCTED CLOSE VIEW, 35MM FEEL, FINAL HERO PROOF. Exactly Aachu and Zuv each drag one opposite end of the same live extension board toward themselves at the same instant because both attached cables are too short: Aachu's clearly attached left hand grips the left plastic end of the board and pulls left; Zuv's clearly attached right hand grips the right plastic end and pulls right. Their free hands stay fully outside the frame. A white phone-charger adapter is visibly inserted in the left socket with its white cable stretched taut toward Aachu's phone just outside the focal area. A black lamp plug is visibly inserted in the right socket with its black cord stretched taut to the intact table lamp. The opposing hand forces rotate and skid the board diagonally; the taut black cord lifts the lamp base into a clear mid-tip toward its padded side, and the moving board physically clips the key bowl so two keys spill along the same impact direction. Both recognizable faces recoil toward the shared consequence with closed mouths, hurt rather than rage. Show exactly two people, exactly two visible hands, one board, two inserted plugs, two taut cables, one intact mid-tip lamp and one struck key bowl. No loose plug in either hand, no empty-cable ambiguity, no third cable, no broken lamp, no fire, no shouting and no extra limb. Reduce the meal to a soft partial foreground trace. Leave a clean upper-left neutral ivory text zone.
